name: Exergy ∞ Engineering Academy
tagline: Learn Cloudflare by building, securing, and observing one real shop.

topics.title: Build and deploy the shop
topics.short: Pages Functions and Workers KV: the stock document, Stripe checkout, and signed webhooks.

topics.title: Product discovery
topics.short: SEO, schema.org JSON-LD, llms.txt, AI crawler access, and the xYang ontology.

topics.title: AI-assisted search
topics.short: Natural-language part search with Workers AI over catalog.json, with a keyword fallback.

topics.title: DNS, delivery, caching, and latency
topics.short: Anycast request paths simulated in lab.net, cache headers and rules, the Cache API, and Tiered Cache.

topics.title: Security at the edge
topics.short: DDoS mitigation, WAF custom rules, bot management, and rate limiting, tested only against your own deployment.

topics.title: Observability
topics.short: Workers Logs, wrangler tail, Analytics Engine, the GraphQL Analytics API, Server-Timing, and measured results.

paths.title: Ship a store on the edge
paths.summary: Deploy the shop, make it discoverable, and prove it works with measurements.
paths.audience: Developers new to Cloudflare who want a working, observable app.

paths.title: Edge performance engineer
paths.summary: Follow a request from DNS to KV, cache what is safe to cache, and measure the difference.
paths.audience: Engineers who own latency and cache-hit ratio.

paths.title: Secure the shop
paths.summary: Layer DDoS protection, WAF rules, and rate limits, then verify them with controlled traffic you own.

paths.title: AI on the edge
paths.summary: Add a Workers AI feature that degrades gracefully, and make the catalog readable by AI crawlers.
paths.audience: Developers adding AI features to production apps.
